name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual NDA allowing two parties to disclose confidential information to each other in connection with a stated business purpose, with standard confidentiality obligations, exceptions, and term.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A framework agreement for a SaaS/cloud service provider and customer covering access and use, support, fees, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: An agreement granting an early customer ('Design Partner') pre-release access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a product development program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: An SLA defining uptime and support response time targets for a cloud service, along with the service credits and termination rights available if those targets are missed.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: A master services agreement for engaging a provider to perform professional services under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, IP ownership, fees, and liability.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A DPA governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and a processor/subprocessor, including subprocessors, international data transfers, security incidents, and audits.

name: Software License Agreement
description: An agreement licensing on-premises or installed software to a customer, covering license scope, restrictions, updates, open source components, warranties, and liability.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A general business partnership agreement covering each party's obligations, fees, mutual trademark licensing, dispute escalation, and standard legal terms.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term agreement allowing a prospective customer to evaluate a product during a pilot period before entering into a longer-term definitive agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA-compliant BAA between a covered entity ('Company') and a business associate ('Provider') governing the use, protection, and breach notification of Protected Health Information (PHI).

name: AI Addendum
description: An addendum supplementing a product agreement with terms specific to AI/ML features, covering use of Input and Output, model training restrictions, IP ownership, and AI-specific disclaimers.
